preview.tournamentOverview: Bellerive Country Club hosts the BMW Championship with a course profile that heavily rewards off-the-tee play. SG OTT carries the highest weight at 1%, followed by SG Total at 3% and SG Putting at 4%. This event serves as the second leg of the FedExCup Playoffs, determining the top 30 players who advance to the Tour Championship.
preview.modelExplainer: The model prioritizes driving distance and accuracy above all, with SG OTT weighted at 1% due to Bellerive's length and narrow fairways. SG Total at 3% captures overall ball-striking, while SG Putting at 4% accounts for the course's undulating greens. Approach play 1%) and around-the-green work 0%) receive lower emphasis given the course's setup.
preview.pickApproach: We tier players by combining tournament-specific rankings with power rankings, favoring those who excel in the heavily weighted SG OTT and SG Total categories. Top-tier bets target players ranked inside the top 10 in both systems with strong off-the-tee metrics. Mid-tier plays include golfers with outlier putting or approach numbers that offset weaker driving performance.

article.title: BMW Championship 2026: Model Ranks Scheffler, McIlroy, Knapp as Top Targets at Bellerive
article.dek: Tournament model places Scheffler #1, McIlroy #2, and Knapp #3 in a 50-player field where SG OTT carries 1% weight.
article.introduction: The model ranks Scottie Scheffler #1 with 868 SG Total and Rory McIlroy #2 with 785 SG Total, while Jake Knapp sits #3 at 002 SG Total. Bellerive's weighting favors off-the-tee play 1%) over approach 1%) and putting 4%). All three targets share the same post-Open research profile: DID_NOT_PLAY at the Open, skipped the Scottish Open, and zero tracked rounds in the major-swing workload window.

sections.heading: Tournament Overview
sections.body: The 50-player BMW Championship at Bellerive Country Club carries course weights of SG OTT 1%, SG Total 3%, and SG Putt 4%. The model ranks the top three targets as Scheffler #1, McIlroy #2, and Knapp #3.

sections.heading: Course Fit
sections.body: Bellerive's 1% SG OTT weight aligns with McIlroy's 799 SG OTT and Scheffler's 623 SG OTT. Knapp's 002 SG Total is driven by 285 SG Putt rather than off-the-tee production.

sections.heading: Recent Form
sections.body: Scheffler's 868 SG Total and McIlroy's 785 SG Total both exceed 5 strokes per round. Knapp's 002 SG Total leads the model field despite lower SG OTT 264).

sections.heading: Post-Open Workload
sections.body: All three targets share the classification NO_TRACKED_ROUNDS (0 tracked rounds) and skipped the Scottish Open. The model does not treat zero tracked rounds as rest or fatigue.

sections.heading: FedExCup Motivation
sections.body: Scheffler enters at FedExCup rank #1, McIlroy at #13, and Knapp at #35—all inside the top 50. The classifications label each player SAFE_TOP_50.

sections.heading: Crossover Research Angles
sections.body: Each target carries the same research note: Skipped the Scottish Open + top-10 model rank. These classifications are contextual and not automatic performance signals.

sections.heading: Outright Targets
sections.body: Scheffler (model rank #1, power rank #1) and McIlroy (model rank #2, power rank #2) are the two outright targets.

sections.heading: Top-10 Targets
sections.body: Scheffler, McIlroy, and Knapp (model rank #3) form the top-10 card. Knapp's 002 SG Total and 285 SG Putt supply the third model-supported selection.

sections.heading: Top-20 Targets
sections.body: The same three players—Scheffler, McIlroy, and Knapp—extend to the top-20 card. All three share identical post-Open classifications and top-10 model placement.

sections.heading: Data Limitations
sections.body: Weather and tee-time data are not available in this pipeline; the article does not make weather- or tee-time-specific claims.

sections.heading: Final Betting Card
sections.body: Tier 1 (model-supported): Scheffler and McIlroy across outright, top-5, top-10, and top-20. Tier 2 (model-supported): Knapp in top-10 and top-20 only.

article.conclusion: Tier 1 model-supported plays: Scheffler and McIlroy in all categories. Tier 2 model-supported play: Knapp in top-10 and top-20.
